text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking of designing a
schedule for <chrname> that
takes full advantage of the area around
us, and I'm taking notes on my phone by
the river when...

text_block_list.name: Large Crow
text_block_list.text: Caaaw! Caaaw!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While dodging a crow's surprise attack, I

accidentally drop my phone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It skips across the gravel, tumbling down
the
incline. I watch in frozen horror as it
hurtles
toward its demise.
I've got it!
choice_data_list: (At this rate, we'll end up in the...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A figure flies past me like the wind. I
only catch a
glimpse of their afterimage
before they dive
straight into the river!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... what a relief! It still turns on.
Looks
like I
made it just in time.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Oh... I am.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I probably shouldn't keep holding
on to your phone while sopping wet.
Here, you'd best
take it before it's too
late.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle looks at me, bewildered. I
can't
possibly leave her in this state! I'd
better...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering there's a cafe nearby, I
quickly run
there and buy her a warm
drink.
choice_data_list: I'll think of a way to warm us up ...
First, let's check your gait for a...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... thank you so much. Sorry you had
to make
the trip.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't have any money on me.
Could you
wait here for me while I run
back to the dorm to
get my wallet?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: A-are you sure?
choice_data_list: You don't have to give it back!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're very kind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her compliment leaves me stunned.
Compared to
what she did, the single
warm drink I bought is
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her compliment leaves me stunned.
Compared to
what she did, the single
warm drink I bought is
nothing.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not injured.
I don't feel any pain,
and
nothing seems off.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Yes, I'm sure! I'll be fine, there's
no need to
worry.
choice_data_list: Are you really going to be okay...?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing that I'm more proud or
protective of than my legs. So many
people did their best to
look after and
care for them, you see.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: So I'll be fine. I am fine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says this with so much confidence,
I'm at a
complete loss for words...
